mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_ATM a INNER JOIN T_CORNER b ON a.TERM_GROUP_ID = b.TERM_GROUP_ID AND a.CORNER_CD = b.CORNER_CD INNER JOIN T_ATM_DEVICE_STATUS d ON a.TERM_GROUP_ID = d.TERM_GROUP_ID AND a.TERM_ID = d.TERM_ID WHERE a.PROTOCOL_TYPE = 'T' AND a.ATM_STATUS IN ('1', '2', '4')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_DAILY_REPORT06 ( BANK_CD, TR_DATE, TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, BOOTH_TYPE_CD, OUT_SRC_CO_CD, GUARD_CO_CD, DES_APPLY, EMV_APPLY, IC_APPLY, IR_APPLY, RF_APPLY, FP_APPLY, OMAN_APPLY, ENCODE_APPLY, FACE, HAND, PROTOCOL_TYPE, CHK_STATUS, BARCODE_APPLY, PB_AUTO_TURN, HANDICAP_ATM ) SELECT #{bankCd} AS BANK_CD , #{trDate} AS TR_DATE , t1.TERM_GROUP_ID AS TERM_GROUP_ID , t1.TERM_ID AS TERM_ID , t1.BOOTH_TYPE_CD AS BOOTH_TYPE_CD , t1.OUTSRC_CO_CD AS OUT_SRC_CO_CD , t1.GUARD_CO_CD AS GUARD_CO_CD , t2.DES_APPLY AS DES_APPLY , t2.EMV_APPLY AS EMV_APPLY , t2.IC_APPLY AS IC_APPLY , t2.IR_APPLY AS IR_APPLY , t2.RF_APPLY AS RF_APPLY , t2.FP_APPLY AS FP_APPLY , t2.OMAN_APPLY AS OMAN_APPLY , t2.ENCODE_APPLY AS ENCODE_APPLY , NVL(SUBSTR(t3.STATUS, 3, 1), '0') AS FACE , NVL(SUBSTR(t3.STATUS, 4, 1), '0') AS HAND , t1.PROTOCOL_TYPE AS PROTOCOL_TYPE , t2.CHK_STATUS AS CHK_STATUS , t2.BARCODE_APPLY AS BARCODE_APPLY , t2.PB_AUTO_TURN AS PB_AUTO_TURN , t2.HANDICAP_ATM AS HANDICAP_ATM FROM ( SELECT a.TERM_GROUP_ID , a.TERM_ID , a.PROTOCOL_TYPE , b.BOOTH_TYPE_CD , b.OUTSRC_CO_CD , b.GUARD_CO_CD FROM T_ATM a INNER JOIN T_CORNER b ON a.TERM_GROUP_ID = b.TERM_GROUP_ID AND a.CORNER_CD = b.CORNER_CD WHERE a.PROTOCOL_TYPE = 'T' AND a.ATM_STATUS IN ('1', '2', '4') -- 1:운영중 2:임시철수 4:임시중단 ) t1 INNER JOIN T_ATM_DEVICE_STATUS t2 ON t1.TERM_GROUP_ID = t2.TERM_GROUP_ID AND t1.TERM_ID = t2.TERM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, MAX(STATUS) AS STATUS FROM T_ATM_UNIT_STATUS WHERE DEVICE_ID = 'G' GROUP BY TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID ) t3 ON t1.TERM_GROUP_ID = t3.TERM_GROUP_ID AND t1.TERM_ID = t3.TERM_ID INNER JOIN T_ATM_GROUP t4 ON t1.TERM_GROUP_ID = t4.TERM_GROUP_ID
